limits: Bounded new-set update, not a replacement for the historical printing audit.
Every explicit physical tuple remains distinct; product distributions do not create extra collectibles.
Existing all-foil 30th IDs are qualified with the visible anniversary mark. No unstamped extra is inferred.
DE Growlithe 106 and Classic Zacian V use labelled English reference artwork. Images do not certify exact specimens.
Some Delta preview images show a 102 denominator; native release lists state 103. This conflict does not create another collectible.
IR provider Cardmarket IDs repeat ordinary-card IDs. All new price candidates remain unconfirmed.
MEP095 Lucario stays in the independent numbered promo series.
JA/KO inventories and historical non-target cards are unchanged.

gallery_review.method: Complete native inventory lists compared with the fixed roster. Delta faces and crowded 30th faces inspected in the preceding research run; both native Lucario cameo faces checked. This is not a claim of exhaustive background-character detection.
